blocks.source: Canto XXIV
blocks.translation: Canto XXIV

blocks.source: In quella parte del giovanetto anno
blocks.translation: In that part of the youthful year wherein

blocks.source: che ’l sole i crin sotto l’Aquario tempra
blocks.translation: The Sun his locks beneath Aquarius tempers,

blocks.source: e già le notti al mezzo dì sen vanno,
blocks.translation: And now the nights draw near to half the day,

blocks.source: quando la brina in su la terra assempra
blocks.translation: What time the hoar-frost copies on the ground

blocks.source: l’imagine di sua sorella bianca,
blocks.translation: The outward semblance of her sister white,

blocks.source: ma poco dura a la sua penna tempra,
blocks.translation: But little lasts the temper of her pen,

blocks.source: lo villanello a cui la roba manca,
blocks.translation: The husbandman, whose forage faileth him,

blocks.source: si leva, e guarda, e vede la campagna
blocks.translation: Rises, and looks, and seeth the champaign

blocks.source: biancheggiar tutta; ond’ ei si batte l’anca,
blocks.translation: All gleaming white, whereat he beats his flank,

blocks.source: ritorna in casa, e qua e là si lagna,
blocks.translation: Returns in doors, and up and down laments,

blocks.source: come ’l tapin che non sa che si faccia;
blocks.translation: Like a poor wretch, who knows not what to do;

blocks.source: poi riede, e la speranza ringavagna,
blocks.translation: Then he returns and hope revives again,

blocks.source: veggendo ’l mondo aver cangiata faccia
blocks.translation: Seeing the world has changed its countenance

blocks.source: in poco d’ora, e prende suo vincastro
blocks.translation: In little time, and takes his shepherd’s crook,

blocks.source: e fuor le pecorelle a pascer caccia.
blocks.translation: And forth the little lambs to pasture drives.

blocks.source: Così mi fece sbigottir lo mastro
blocks.translation: Thus did the Master fill me with alarm,

blocks.source: quand’ io li vidi sì turbar la fronte,
blocks.translation: When I beheld his forehead so disturbed,

blocks.source: e così tosto al mal giunse lo ’mpiastro;
blocks.translation: And to the ailment came as soon the plaster.

blocks.source: ché, come noi venimmo al guasto ponte,
blocks.translation: For as we came unto the ruined bridge,

blocks.source: lo duca a me si volse con quel piglio
blocks.translation: The Leader turned to me with that sweet look

blocks.source: dolce ch’io vidi prima a piè del monte.
blocks.translation: Which at the mountain’s foot I first beheld.

blocks.source: Le braccia aperse, dopo alcun consiglio
blocks.translation: His arms he opened, after some advisement

blocks.source: eletto seco riguardando prima
blocks.translation: Within himself elected, looking first

blocks.source: ben la ruina, e diedemi di piglio.
blocks.translation: Well at the ruin, and laid hold of me.

blocks.source: E come quei ch’adopera ed estima,
blocks.translation: And even as he who acts and meditates,

blocks.source: che sempre par che ’nnanzi si proveggia,
blocks.translation: For aye it seems that he provides beforehand,

blocks.source: così, levando me sù ver’ la cima
blocks.translation: So upward lifting me towards the summit

blocks.source: d’un ronchione, avvisava un’altra scheggia
blocks.translation: Of a huge rock, he scanned another crag,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Sovra quella poi t’aggrappa;
blocks.translation: Saying: “To that one grapple afterwards,

blocks.source: ma tenta pria s’è tal ch’ella ti reggia».
blocks.translation: But try first if ’tis such that it will hold thee.”

blocks.source: Non era via da vestito di cappa,
blocks.translation: This was no way for one clothed with a cloak;

blocks.source: ché noi a pena, ei lieve e io sospinto,
blocks.translation: For hardly we, he light, and I pushed upward,

blocks.source: potavam sù montar di chiappa in chiappa.
blocks.translation: Were able to ascend from jag to jag.

blocks.source: E se non fosse che da quel precinto
blocks.translation: And had it not been, that upon that precinct

blocks.source: più che da l’altro era la costa corta,
blocks.translation: Shorter was the ascent than on the other,

blocks.source: non so di lui, ma io sarei ben vinto.
blocks.translation: He I know not, but I had been dead beat.

blocks.source: Ma perché Malebolge inver’ la porta
blocks.translation: But because Malebolge tow’rds the mouth

blocks.source: del bassissimo pozzo tutta pende,
blocks.translation: Of the profoundest well is all inclining,

blocks.source: lo sito di ciascuna valle porta
blocks.translation: The structure of each valley doth import

blocks.source: che l’una costa surge e l’altra scende;
blocks.translation: That one bank rises and the other sinks.

blocks.source: noi pur venimmo al fine in su la punta
blocks.translation: Still we arrived at length upon the point

blocks.source: onde l’ultima pietra si scoscende.
blocks.translation: Wherefrom the last stone breaks itself asunder.

blocks.source: La lena m’era del polmon sì munta
blocks.translation: The breath was from my lungs so milked away,

blocks.source: quand’ io fui sù, ch’i’ non potea più oltre,
blocks.translation: When I was up, that I could go no farther,

blocks.source: anzi m’assisi ne la prima giunta.
blocks.translation: Nay, I sat down upon my first arrival.

blocks.source: «Omai convien che tu così ti spoltre»,
blocks.translation: “Now it behoves thee thus to put off sloth,”

blocks.source: disse ’l maestro; «ché, seggendo in piuma,
blocks.translation: My Master said; “for sitting upon down,

blocks.source: in fama non si vien, né sotto coltre;
blocks.translation: Or under quilt, one cometh not to fame,

blocks.source: sanza la qual chi sua vita consuma,
blocks.translation: Withouten which whoso his life consumes

blocks.source: cotal vestigio in terra di sé lascia,
blocks.translation: Such vestige leaveth of himself on earth,

blocks.source: qual fummo in aere e in acqua la schiuma.
blocks.translation: As smoke in air or in the water foam.

blocks.source: E però leva sù; vinci l’ambascia
blocks.translation: And therefore raise thee up, o’ercome the anguish

blocks.source: con l’animo che vince ogne battaglia,
blocks.translation: With spirit that o’ercometh every battle,

blocks.source: se col suo grave corpo non s’accascia.
blocks.translation: If with its heavy body it sink not.

blocks.source: Più lunga scala convien che si saglia;
blocks.translation: A longer stairway it behoves thee mount;

blocks.source: non basta da costoro esser partito.
blocks.translation: ’Tis not enough from these to have departed;

blocks.source: Se tu mi ’ntendi, or fa sì che ti vaglia».
blocks.translation: Let it avail thee, if thou understand me.”

blocks.source: Leva’mi allor, mostrandomi fornito
blocks.translation: Then I uprose, showing myself provided

blocks.source: meglio di lena ch’i’ non mi sentia,
blocks.translation: Better with breath than I did feel myself,

blocks.source: e dissi: «Va, ch’i’ son forte e ardito».
blocks.translation: And said: “Go on, for I am strong and bold.”

blocks.source: Su per lo scoglio prendemmo la via,
blocks.translation: Upward we took our way along the crag,

blocks.source: ch’era ronchioso, stretto e malagevole,
blocks.translation: Which jagged was, and narrow, and difficult,

blocks.source: ed erto più assai che quel di pria.
blocks.translation: And more precipitous far than that before.

blocks.source: Parlando andava per non parer fievole;
blocks.translation: Speaking I went, not to appear exhausted;

blocks.source: onde una voce uscì de l’altro fosso,
blocks.translation: Whereat a voice from the next moat came forth,

blocks.source: a parole formar disconvenevole.
blocks.translation: Not well adapted to articulate words.

blocks.source: Non so che disse, ancor che sovra ’l dosso
blocks.translation: I know not what it said, though o’er the back

blocks.source: fossi de l’arco già che varca quivi;
blocks.translation: I now was of the arch that passes there;

blocks.source: ma chi parlava ad ire parea mosso.
blocks.translation: But he seemed moved to anger who was speaking.

blocks.source: Io era vòlto in giù, ma li occhi vivi
blocks.translation: I was bent downward, but my living eyes

blocks.source: non poteano ire al fondo per lo scuro;
blocks.translation: Could not attain the bottom, for the dark;

blocks.source: per ch’io: «Maestro, fa che tu arrivi
blocks.translation: Wherefore I: “Master, see that thou arrive

blocks.source: da l’altro cinghio e dismontiam lo muro;
blocks.translation: At the next round, and let us descend the wall;

blocks.source: ché, com’ i’ odo quinci e non intendo,
blocks.translation: For as from hence I hear and understand not,

blocks.source: così giù veggio e neente affiguro».
blocks.translation: So I look down and nothing I distinguish.”

blocks.source: «Altra risposta», disse, «non ti rendo
blocks.translation: “Other response,” he said, “I make thee not,

blocks.source: se non lo far; ché la dimanda onesta
blocks.translation: Except the doing; for the modest asking

blocks.source: si de’ seguir con l’opera tacendo».
blocks.translation: Ought to be followed by the deed in silence.”

blocks.source: Noi discendemmo il ponte da la testa
blocks.translation: We from the bridge descended at its head,

blocks.source: dove s’aggiugne con l’ottava ripa,
blocks.translation: Where it connects itself with the eighth bank,

blocks.source: e poi mi fu la bolgia manifesta:
blocks.translation: And then was manifest to me the Bolgia;

blocks.source: e vidivi entro terribile stipa
blocks.translation: And I beheld therein a terrible throng

blocks.source: di serpenti, e di sì diversa mena
blocks.translation: Of serpents, and of such a monstrous kind,

blocks.source: che la memoria il sangue ancor mi scipa.
blocks.translation: That the remembrance still congeals my blood

blocks.source: Più non si vanti Libia con sua rena;
blocks.translation: Let Libya boast no longer with her sand;

blocks.source: ché se chelidri, iaculi e faree
blocks.translation: For if Chelydri, Jaculi, and Phareae

blocks.source: produce, e cencri con anfisibena,
blocks.translation: She breeds, with Cenchri and with Amphisbaena,

blocks.source: né tante pestilenzie né sì ree
blocks.translation: Neither so many plagues nor so malignant

blocks.source: mostrò già mai con tutta l’Etïopia
blocks.translation: E’er showed she with all Ethiopia,

blocks.source: né con ciò che di sopra al Mar Rosso èe.
blocks.translation: Nor with whatever on the Red Sea is!

blocks.source: Tra questa cruda e tristissima copia
blocks.translation: Among this cruel and most dismal throng

blocks.source: corrëan genti nude e spaventate,
blocks.translation: People were running naked and affrighted.

blocks.source: sanza sperar pertugio o elitropia:
blocks.translation: Without the hope of hole or heliotrope.

blocks.source: con serpi le man dietro avean legate;
blocks.translation: They had their hands with serpents bound behind them;

blocks.source: quelle ficcavan per le ren la coda
blocks.translation: These riveted upon their reins the tail

blocks.source: e ’l capo, ed eran dinanzi aggroppate.
blocks.translation: And head, and were in front of them entwined.

blocks.source: Ed ecco a un ch’era da nostra proda,
blocks.translation: And lo! at one who was upon our side

blocks.source: s’avventò un serpente che ’l trafisse
blocks.translation: There darted forth a serpent, which transfixed him

blocks.source: là dove ’l collo a le spalle s’annoda.
blocks.translation: There where the neck is knotted to the shoulders.

blocks.source: Né O sì tosto mai né I si scrisse,
blocks.translation: Nor ‘O’ so quickly e’er, nor ‘I’ was written,

blocks.source: com’ el s’accese e arse, e cener tutto
blocks.translation: As he took fire, and burned; and ashes wholly

blocks.source: convenne che cascando divenisse;
blocks.translation: Behoved it that in falling he became.

blocks.source: e poi che fu a terra sì distrutto,
blocks.translation: And when he on the ground was thus destroyed,

blocks.source: la polver si raccolse per sé stessa
blocks.translation: The ashes drew together, and of themselves

blocks.source: e ’n quel medesmo ritornò di butto.
blocks.translation: Into himself they instantly returned.

blocks.source: Così per li gran savi si confessa
blocks.translation: Even thus by the great sages ’tis confessed

blocks.source: che la fenice more e poi rinasce,
blocks.translation: The phoenix dies, and then is born again,

blocks.source: quando al cinquecentesimo anno appressa;
blocks.translation: When it approaches its five-hundredth year;

blocks.source: erba né biado in sua vita non pasce,
blocks.translation: On herb or grain it feeds not in its life,

blocks.source: ma sol d’incenso lagrime e d’amomo,
blocks.translation: But only on tears of incense and amomum,

blocks.source: e nardo e mirra son l’ultime fasce.
blocks.translation: And nard and myrrh are its last winding-sheet.

blocks.source: E qual è quel che cade, e non sa como,
blocks.translation: And as he is who falls, and knows not how,

blocks.source: per forza di demon ch’a terra il tira,
blocks.translation: By force of demons who to earth down drag him,

blocks.source: o d’altra oppilazion che lega l’omo,
blocks.translation: Or other oppilation that binds man,

blocks.source: quando si leva, che ’ntorno si mira
blocks.translation: When he arises and around him looks,

blocks.source: tutto smarrito de la grande angoscia
blocks.translation: Wholly bewildered by the mighty anguish

blocks.source: ch’elli ha sofferta, e guardando sospira:
blocks.translation: Which he has suffered, and in looking sighs;

blocks.source: tal era ’l peccator levato poscia.
blocks.translation: Such was that sinner after he had risen.

blocks.source: Oh potenza di Dio, quant’ è severa,
blocks.translation: Justice of God! O how severe it is,

blocks.source: che cotai colpi per vendetta croscia!
blocks.translation: That blows like these in vengeance poureth down!

blocks.source: Lo duca il domandò poi chi ello era;
blocks.translation: The Guide thereafter asked him who he was;

blocks.source: per ch’ei rispuose: «Io piovvi di Toscana,
blocks.translation: Whence he replied: “I rained from Tuscany

blocks.source: poco tempo è, in questa gola fiera.
blocks.translation: A short time since into this cruel gorge.

blocks.source: Vita bestial mi piacque e non umana,
blocks.translation: A bestial life, and not a human, pleased me,

blocks.source: sì come a mul ch’i’ fui; son Vanni Fucci
blocks.translation: Even as the mule I was; I’m Vanni Fucci,

blocks.source: bestia, e Pistoia mi fu degna tana».
blocks.translation: Beast, and Pistoia was my worthy den.”

blocks.source: E ïo al duca: «Dilli che non mucci,
blocks.translation: And I unto the Guide: “Tell him to stir not,

blocks.source: e domanda che colpa qua giù ’l pinse;
blocks.translation: And ask what crime has thrust him here below,

blocks.source: ch’io ’l vidi uomo di sangue e di crucci».
blocks.translation: For once a man of blood and wrath I saw him.”

blocks.source: E ’l peccator, che ’ntese, non s’infinse,
blocks.translation: And the sinner, who had heard, dissembled not,

blocks.source: ma drizzò verso me l’animo e ’l volto,
blocks.translation: But unto me directed mind and face,

blocks.source: e di trista vergogna si dipinse;
blocks.translation: And with a melancholy shame was painted.

blocks.source: poi disse: «Più mi duol che tu m’hai colto
blocks.translation: Then said: “It pains me more that thou hast caught me

blocks.source: ne la miseria dove tu mi vedi,
blocks.translation: Amid this misery where thou seest me,

blocks.source: che quando fui de l’altra vita tolto.
blocks.translation: Than when I from the other life was taken.

blocks.source: Io non posso negar quel che tu chiedi;
blocks.translation: What thou demandest I cannot deny;

blocks.source: in giù son messo tanto perch’ io fui
blocks.translation: So low am I put down because I robbed

blocks.source: ladro a la sagrestia d’i belli arredi,
blocks.translation: The sacristy of the fair ornaments,

blocks.source: e falsamente già fu apposto altrui.
blocks.translation: And falsely once ’twas laid upon another;

blocks.source: Ma perché di tal vista tu non godi,
blocks.translation: But that thou mayst not such a sight enjoy,

blocks.source: se mai sarai di fuor da’ luoghi bui,
blocks.translation: If thou shalt e’er be out of the dark places,

blocks.source: apri li orecchi al mio annunzio, e odi.
blocks.translation: Thine ears to my announcement ope and hear:

blocks.source: Pistoia in pria d’i Neri si dimagra;
blocks.translation: Pistoia first of Neri groweth meagre;

blocks.source: poi Fiorenza rinova gente e modi.
blocks.translation: Then Florence doth renew her men and manners;

blocks.source: Tragge Marte vapor di Val di Magra
blocks.translation: Mars draws a vapour up from Val di Magra,

blocks.source: ch’è di torbidi nuvoli involuto;
blocks.translation: Which is with turbid clouds enveloped round,

blocks.source: e con tempesta impetüosa e agra
blocks.translation: And with impetuous and bitter tempest

blocks.source: sovra Campo Picen fia combattuto;
blocks.translation: Over Campo Picen shall be the battle;

blocks.source: ond’ ei repente spezzerà la nebbia,
blocks.translation: When it shall suddenly rend the mist asunder,

blocks.source: sì ch’ogne Bianco ne sarà feruto.
blocks.translation: So that each Bianco shall thereby be smitten.

blocks.source: E detto l’ho perché doler ti debbia!».
blocks.translation: And this I’ve said that it may give thee pain.”
